title: Applet: use middle click on applet to toggle presentation mode
line: Middle-clicking the Display Configuration icon in the system tray now turns presentation mode on or off.
explanation: Other tray applets (Notifications, Power and Battery, Brightness, Bluetooth, Networks) do something useful on middle click, but the Display Configuration applet ignored it: the tray already emits secondaryActivated for it, and nothing handled that. The presentation mode logic also lived inside the popup's switch, so it could only be used with the popup open. The change moves the toggle into the applet root, handles middle click (Plasmoid.onSecondaryActivated, like bluedevil and plasma-nm) by toggling it, binds the switch to the same state, and adds a middle-click hint to the tooltip in the same wording as the battery and notifications applets.

commits.message:
plasmoid: toggle presentation mode on middle click

Unlike other tray applets, middle-clicking the Display Configuration
icon did nothing. Move the presentation mode toggle out of the switch so
middle-click can use it too, and mention it in the tooltip like others.

BUG: 426427

media.caption: Master: after middle-clicking Display Configuration in the tray popup, nothing happens; presentation mode stays off and no icon appears in the panel
Patched: middle click turns presentation mode on; the icon shows in the panel and its tooltip says how to turn it off
Master: open the tray, middle-click Display Configuration, close the tray: nothing changes
Patched: middle click enables presentation mode (icon moves to the panel), middle-clicking the panel icon disables it again
